title: Gut microbiome (16S) -> colorectal cancer / inflammatory bowel disease

crc_baxter.note: Colorectal cancer (120) vs healthy (172) stool samples, Baxter 2016 (MiSeq V4, one sample per subject). Published RF baseline on genus abundances ~0.77 AUROC (Duvallet 2017). The final champion is also applied, unchanged, to four other CRC studies (different OTU sets) -- solutions that work on taxonomy names (not study-specific denovo ids) generalize across studies.

ibd_pooled.note: Inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's or UC) vs controls, stool 16S POOLED over four studies (Gevers 2014 RISK, Alm, Engstrand, Huttenhower; ctx meta 'study'); columns are RDP taxonomy lineages (OTUs merged by lineage across studies). Strong study/batch effects: sequencing depth, region and protocols differ per study, and case/control ratios differ per study. Published single-study RF baselines 0.66-0.84 AUROC (Duvallet 2017). Metric: within-study AUROC (protocol v2).
